description: Cross-repo contract fixture for the kid-prefixed trust token. Format: "<kid>.<base64(IV[12]+AES-256-GCM ciphertext+tag[16])>". kid is the plaintext clientId, must equal payload.clientId, and the AES key is sha256(secret) for the "lobehub-market_tcs_" secret format. The same file lives in market (src/libs/trusted-client/__tests__/fixtures) and lobehub-cpc (src/libs/trusted-client/__fixtures__). The secret is a public test value, not a credential.
